def table_source(encoding):
    key = KEYS.get(encoding, encoding.capitalize())
    cases = "".join(f"        case 0x{number:02x}: return RdnaOpcode::{name};\n"
                    for number, name in ENTRIES.get(encoding, {0: "Placeholder" + key}).items())
    return f"RdnaOpcode lookup{key}Opcode(uint32_t op)\n{{\n    switch (op)\n    {{\n{cases}    }}\n}}\n\n"


def write_tree(root, tables=None, throws=True):
    root = Path(root)
    files = {
        f"{DECODER}Tables.cpp": "".join(table_source(e) for e in (tables or shader_scan.REQUIRED_TABLES)),
        f"{DECODER}Rules.cpp": (
            "bool isUnsupportedVop3EncodedVop2Alias(uint32_t op) { return op == 0x05; }\n"
            "bool isVop2LiteralMadOpcode(uint32_t op) { return op == 0x06; }\n"
            "void dispatch(RdnaInstructionFamily f) { switch (f) { case RdnaInstructionFamily::EXP: return; default: return; } }\n"
            "bool hasDppForm(RdnaOpcode op) { switch (op) { case RdnaOpcode::VCvtF32I32: return false; default: return true; } }\n"
            "bool acceptsDpp8(RdnaOpcode op) { switch (op) { case RdnaOpcode::VAddF32: return false; default: return true; } }\n"),
        "core/shader/recompiler/Translation/Translate.cpp": "".join(
            f"void TranslationContext::{emit}(const Instruction& i)\n{{\n    switch (i.op)\n    {{\n{cases}    }}\n}}\n"
            for emit, cases in (("emitScalar", "        case RdnaOpcode::SMovB32: break;\n"),
                                ("emitVector", "        case RdnaOpcode::VCmpEqF32: break;\n"), ("emitMemory", ""),
                                ("emitInterpolation", "        case RdnaOpcode::VCvtF32I32: break;\n")))
        + "void TranslateInstruction(const Instruction& i)\n{\n    switch (i.family)\n    {\n        case RdnaInstructionFamily::EXP: break;\n    }\n}\n",
    }
    if throws:
        files["core/shader/recompiler/Ir/Lower.cpp"] = (
            'void a() { throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported image type"); }\n'
            'void b() { throw std::runtime_error("bad size"); }\n'
            'void c() { try { f(); } catch (...) { throw; } }\n'
            '// throw std::runtime_error("unsupported in a comment");\n'
            '/* throw std::runtime_error("not implemented in a block comment"); */\n'
            'void d() { throw UnsupportedInstructionError(op); }\n'
            'void e() { throw std::runtime_error("semi; colon is not implemented"); }\n')
        files["core/shader/recompiler/Top.cpp"] = 'void f() { throw std::runtime_error("not implemented yet"); }\n'
        files["core/shader/recompiler/Ir/tests/LowerTests.cpp"] = 'void t() { throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported"); }\n'
    for path, text in files.items():
        (root / path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (root / path).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    formats = {
        "core/libs/prx/libSceAgcDriver/Graphics/src/Formats.cpp": (
            "enum class IrBufferFormat : std::uint32_t { Invalid = 0, R8 = 1, R16 = 2, R32 = 3, Rg8 = 4 };\n"
            "constexpr std::array DefinedImageFormats = { std::pair{1u, 4u}, std::pair{7u, 7u} };\n"
            "constexpr FormatInfo kFormatInfoTable[] = { {IrBufferFormat::R8, true}, {IrBufferFormat::R16, false}, {IrBufferFormat::R32, true} };\n"
            "FormatInfo GetFormatInfo(IrBufferFormat f)\n{\n    switch (f)\n    {\n        case IrBufferFormat::R16: return {};\n        case IrBufferFormat::R32: return {};\n    }\n}\n"),
        "core/libs/prx/libSceAgcDriver/Graphics/src/TextureFormat.cpp": (
            "constexpr Entry kFormatLookup[] = { {1, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM}, {3, VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT}, {9, VK_FORMAT_R8_UINT} };\n"
            "std::uint32_t remapGuestFormat(std::uint32_t f) { return f == 4 || f == 7 ? 3 : f; }\n"),
    }
    for path, text in formats.items():
        (root / path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (root / path).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

class ScanTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_known_answers_on_a_small_tree(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            write_tree(directory)
            result = shader_scan.measure(directory, ISA)
        self.assertEqual(result["instructions"], {"total": 14, "decoded": 10, "translated": 5})
        self.assertEqual(result["dpp"], {"total": 3, "decoded": 1})
        self.assertEqual(result["unsupported_throws"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result["throw_areas"], [{"name": "Ir", "count": 3}, {"name": "Recompiler", "count": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(result["formats"], {"total": 5, "sampled": 2, "buffer": 2, "host": 4})
        self.assertEqual({f["encoding"] + " " + f["form"]: f["missing"] for f in result["forms"] if f["missing"]},
                         {"SOP1 base": ["S_NEW"], "VOP1 dpp16": ["V_CVT_F32_I32"], "VOP2 vop3": ["V_MAC_F32", "V_PAST_F32"], "VOP2 dpp8": ["V_ADD_F32"], "VOPC vop3": ["V_CMP_NEW"]})
        self.assertEqual({f["encoding"] + " " + f["form"]: f["untranslated"] for f in result["forms"] if f["untranslated"]},
                         {"VOP2 base": ["V_ADD_F32"], "VOP2 vop3": ["V_ADD_F32", "V_FIRST_F32", "V_LAST_F32"], "VOP1 vop3": ["V_MOV_B32"], "VOP2 dpp16": ["V_ADD_F32"]})
        self.assertEqual(result["untranslated"], ["V_ADD_F32", "V_FIRST_F32", "V_LAST_F32", "V_MOV_B32"])
        by_form = {(f["encoding"], f["form"]): (f["total"], f["decoded"], f["translated"]) for f in result["forms"]}
        self.assertEqual(by_form, {("SOP1", "base"): (2, 1, 1), ("VOP2", "base"): (1, 1, 0), ("VOP2", "vop3"): (5, 3, 0),
                                   ("VOP2", "dpp16"): (1, 1, 0), ("VOP2", "dpp8"): (1, 0, 0),
                                   ("VOP1", "base"): (1, 1, 1), ("VOP1", "vop3"): (2, 2, 1), ("VOP1", "dpp16"): (1, 0, 0),
                                   ("VOPC", "vop3"): (2, 1, 1), ("EXP", "base"): (1, 1, 1)})

    def test_unsupported_throws_skip_comments_rethrows_other_messages_and_tests(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            write_tree(directory)
            sites = shader_scan.unsupported_throws(shader_scan.read_tree(directory))
        self.assertEqual([(s["file"], s["line"]) for s in sites], [("Ir/Lower.cpp", 1), ("Ir/Lower.cpp", 6), ("Ir/Lower.cpp", 7), ("Top.cpp", 1)])
        self.assertEqual(sites[0]["message"], "Unsupported image type")

    def test_a_missing_opcode_table_stops_the_scan_naming_it(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            write_tree(directory, tables=[e for e in shader_scan.REQUIRED_TABLES if e != "SOP1"])
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(shader_scan.ScanError, "no SOP1 opcode table"):
                shader_scan.measure(directory, ISA)

    def test_a_missing_translator_stops_the_scan(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            write_tree(directory)
            (Path(directory) / "core/shader/recompiler/Translation/Translate.cpp").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(shader_scan.ScanError, r"TranslationContext::emitScalar\(\)"):
                shader_scan.measure(directory, ISA)

    def test_comments_keep_offsets_and_literals(self):
        text = 'a // x\nb /* y\nz */ c "// not a comment"\n'
        stripped = shader_scan.strip_comments(text)
        self.assertEqual(len(stripped), len(text))

6:- **Every exported PS5 function with `APS5_VABI` must have exactly one declaration in a header reachable through the library's `<library>.hpp`. Duplicate declarations in headers, `.cpp` files and tests are forbidden. This is checked by the Python test [`public_headers`](core/libs/tests/test_public_headers.py).**
18:- Don't add tests that only check that a symbol is exported: a missing export already fails at startup.
19:- Each test finishes in 30 s on the CI runners, Vulkan tests included (Linux runs them on lavapipe), counting the first run with no shader cache. ctest runs in parallel there, so a slow test competes for the cores and times out on some runs and not others. Split or shrink a test that gets close instead of raising its timeout. CI reports every test over 30 s as a warning on the pull request.
21:## Build and test
25:For relinker changes, use the [relinker-only build](docs/dev/BUILD.md#relinker-only) to build and test without third-party submodules, system libraries or a GPU. It also works on macOS. Changes to system libraries or shaders still need the full build and relevant runtime tests.
28:cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=ON
30:ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
33:Python 3 is optional; without it some relinker tests are not registered.
35:Every push to `main`, including a merged pull request, automatically runs full Linux and Windows builds and tests, which include the relinker tests, using the pushed commit without contributor checks. The relinker-only build and tests run separately on macOS, for arm64 and x86_64, and the relinker-only build with the address sanitizer runs on Linux, only when the push changes a file the relinker-only build uses.
37:For pull requests, full Linux and Windows builds and tests run only when a collaborator with write access selects Actions > Build > Run workflow on `main` and enters up to 40 numbers of open pull requests targeting `main`, separated by spaces or commas; they are merged in that order and built together. A collaborator can start the same manual run from the command line, replacing `1234` with the pull request numbers:
43:This manual run also builds and tests the relinker on Linux, Windows and macOS when the pull request changes a file the relinker-only build uses, regardless of the author's previous contributions. The relinker matrix also runs automatically when a pull request targeting `main` is opened, updated or reopened, if its author already has a commit in `main` and it changes a file the relinker-only build uses; full builds never run automatically for pull requests. Every job that runs automatically for pull requests runs only when the pull request changes its files: a `paths` filter on the `pull_request` trigger, or `needs: eligibility` with an `if` on the files output it sets in `build.yml`. The Conventions check fails a workflow change that adds a job without one. All build jobs build the selected pull request merged into the current `main` (GitHub's merge commit), so a pull request that no longer merges cleanly must be rebased first. New commits require another manual run for full builds.
45:With `--field full=false`, the manual run skips the full builds and runs only the relinker matrix on Linux, Windows and macOS, if the pull request changes a file the relinker-only build uses, such as the Python tools and their tests in `tools/`.
47:With `--field linux=false`, the manual run skips the full Linux build and adds Linux to the relinker matrix, if the pull requests change a file the relinker-only build uses. With `--field select=true`, the full builds build and run only the tests whose build inputs the pull requests change; push builds of `main` always run every test.
63:- An AGC test executable and its tests are registered in `core/libs/prx/libSceAgcDriver/tests/cmake/<executable>.cmake`; the tests of an execution test in `tests/execution/` go in the fragment of its `agc_driver_<name>_tests` executable. `CMakeLists.txt` includes the fragments in sorted order, so a fragment uses nothing another fragment defines. A pull request whose change to `libSceAgcDriver/CMakeLists.txt` conflicts after the split rebases and runs `python3 tools/agc_test_split.py resolve` during the stopped rebase, which moves its registrations to their fragments and leaves conflict markers where `main` changed the same lines.
69:- For GPU changes, list each tested GPU's vendor, model, driver and OS on the checklist line. CI runs GPU tests only on lavapipe, so reviewers may ask for a run on another vendor before merging.
72:- Run the tests before opening the pull request and describe what was tested (OS, title or homebrew).
74:- Changes to the AGC driver, the shader recompiler or VideoOut run the same focused tests on `main` and the change with `VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS=VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation`, `ANYPS5_NO_SHADER_CACHE=1` and `ANYPS5_REQUIRE_VULKAN=1` using `ctest -V` from the same machine and GPU, confirm neither log reports `was not found but was requested by env var VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS`, confirm the change introduces no new `VUID-` validation errors compared with `main`, and name each GPU the GPU tests ran on (vendor, model, driver, OS) on the `GPUs tested` checklist line. CI runs these tests only on lavapipe, and hardware drivers fail where lavapipe and other vendors pass, so a reviewer can ask for a run on another vendor before merging.
